2173-2981-4574-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2173-2981-4574-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

647-3259-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
647-3259-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

671-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
671-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4089-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4089-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4089-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-4359-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-4359-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

586-5258-5618-6798-7646.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

618-7622.description:
Activate the mutated Regal Leosaur and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

3259-6642-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6642-7297.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6642-7297.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

141-5686-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

2511-3991-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3967-4484-4871-5643-6747.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3967-4484-4871-5643-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
3967-4484-4871-5643-6747.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3967-4484-4871-5643-6747.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1563-1978-3430.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact creature token that does not have summoning sickness.
1563-1978-3430.description:
Activate an artifact creature token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature token.
Repeat.

856-4050-4321-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4050-4321-5632.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token, Clue token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

372-1090-1971.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1090-1971.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Yannik and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Restoration Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Yannik to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Yannik and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Yannik trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Yannik leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Yannik and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2034-5263-6243.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Repeat.

1183-1988-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Pentavus.
You control at least one additional creature.
1183-1988-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
Repeat.

751-974-2472.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
751-974-2472.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Song of the Worldsoul triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may use Song of the Worldsoul's trigger to target any other token you control instead.

147-313-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-313-5147.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

224-916-1737-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Prototype Portal.
Prototype Portal does not have summoning sickness.
224-916-1737-4832.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by tapping it, creating a token copy of Vault of Whispers.
When the Vault of Whispers token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

283-890-1029-5162.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Kwain.
Kwain and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
283-890-1029-5162.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kwain by tapping it.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kwain's ability.
Resolve the copy of Kwain's ability, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life, and allowing your opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Palladium Myr.
Resolve Kwain's ability, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life, and allowing your opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Kwain.
Repeat.

586-1435-2232-3168.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {1}{B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's ability, returning Malakir Blood-Priest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Priest of Gix ability, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Malakir Blood-Priest by paying {B}.
Malakir Blood-Priest enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Malakir Blood-Priest's ability, causing each opponent to lose at least 1 life and you to gain at least 1 life.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's ability, returning Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
